create_attachment: create an Attachment object with base64 encoded image data and a mime type
convert_attachment_to_openai_json: convert an Attachment to OpenAI image_url JSON format for multimodal API calls
convert_attachments_to_pil_images: convert a list of Attachment objects into PIL Image objects for processing
convert_pil_images_to_attachments: convert a list of PIL Image objects into base64 encoded Attachment objects
validate_attachment_fields: validate that an Attachment has non-empty mime and base64_data fields on construction
